description: Shape of one included_matches[].public_facts object for schema_id dbd-1v1-symmetric, version 1.0. rounds_won_by_side.description: Rounds each side won. Keys are exactly this match's two side_id values. The winning side has 2; the other has 0 or 1. Section 2.2.
